arxiv-2102-13387.title: Ethical Issues in Empirical Studies using Student Subjects: Re-visiting Practices and Perceptions
arxiv-2102-13387.creator: Grischa Liebel, Shalini Chakraborty
arxiv-2102-13387.description: Abstract Context: Using student subjects in empirical studies has been discussed extensively from a methodological perspective in Software Engineering (SE), but there is a lack of similar discussion surrounding ethical aspects of doing so. As students are in a subordinate relationship to their instructors, such a discussion is needed.

arxiv-2104-05838.title: Theory of parametric x-ray optical wavemixing processes
arxiv-2104-05838.creator: Dietrich Krebs, Nina Rohringer
arxiv-2104-05838.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dietrich Krebs, Nina Rohringer. Enabled by x-ray free-electron lasers, nonlinear optical phenomena can be explored in the x-ray domain nowadays. Among the multitude of newly accessible processes, this theoretical study focuses parametric x-ray optical wavemixing for closer investigation. Specifically, we develop a framework based on non-relativistic QED to describe x-ray optical sum- and difference-frequency generation as well as x-ray parametric down-conversion on equal footing.

arxiv-2110-05262.title: The Epoch of Reionization in Warm Dark Matter Scenarios
arxiv-2110-05262.creator: Massimiliano Romanello *, Nicola Menci, Marco Castellano
arxiv-2110-05262.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate how the Reionization process is affected by early galaxy formation in different cosmological scenarios. We use a semi-analytic model with suppressed initial power spectra to obtain the UV Luminosity Function in thermal Warm Dark Matter and sterile neutrino cosmologies.

arxiv-2111-07988.title: The stochastic heat equation with multiplicative Lévy noise: Existence, Moments, and Intermittency
arxiv-2111-07988.creator: Quentin Berger, Carsten Chong, Hubert Lacoin
arxiv-2111-07988.description: Abstract . We study the stochastic heat equation (SHE) ∂ t u = 1 2 ​ Δ ​ u + β ​ u ​ ξ \partial_{t}u=\frac{1}{2}\Delta u+\beta u\xi driven by a multiplicative Lévy noise ξ \xi with positive jumps and amplitude β > 0 \beta>0 , in arbitrary dimension d ≥ 1 d\geq 1 .

arxiv-2203-06453.description: Abstract . The ellipsoidal capacity function of a symplectic four manifold X X measures how much the form on X X must be dilated in order for it to admit an embedded ellipsoid of eccentricity z z . In most cases there are just finitely many obstructions to such an embedding besides the volume.

arxiv-2208-04100.title: Noise-resilient phase estimation with randomized compiling
arxiv-2208-04100.creator: Yanwu Gu, Yunheng Ma, Nicolò Forcellini, Dong E. Liu
arxiv-2208-04100.description: Abstract We develop an error mitigation method for the control-free phase estimation. We prove a theorem that under the first-order correction, the phases of a unitary operator are immune to the noise channels with only Hermitian Kraus operators, and therefore, certain benign types of noise for phase estimation are identified.

arxiv-2304-08646.title: Quantization of the anisotropic conformal Hořava theory
arxiv-2304-08646.creator: Jorge Bellorín
arxiv-2304-08646.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jorge Bellorín. 1
Introduction

The Hořava theory
[
1
]
provides a scenario for studying quantum gravity with anisotropic symmetries between time and space, resulting in the breaking of the local Lorentz symmetry. The anisotropy is introduced with the aim of having a renormalizable theory of quantum gravity, which is a fundamental open question in theoretical physics, and simultaneously with quantum unitarity.

arxiv-2401-04635.title: Graph products and measure equivalence: classification, rigidity, and quantitative aspects
arxiv-2401-04635.creator: Amandine Escalier, Camille Horbez
arxiv-2401-04635.description: Abstract We study graph products of groups from the viewpoint of measured group theory. We first establish a full measure equivalence classification of graph products of countably infinite groups over finite simple graphs with no transvection and no partial conjugation.

arxiv-2407-17516.title: Amplifying the kinematics of origami mechanisms with spring joints
arxiv-2407-17516.description: Abstract Due to its rigid foldability and predictable kinematics, the reverse fold is the fundamental mechanism behind some of the most well known origami kinematic structures, including the Miura Ori, Yoshimura, and waterbomb patterns. However, the reverse fold only has one parameter to control its behavior: the starting fold angle.

arxiv-2407-20631.title: Hedgehog topological defects in 3D amorphous solids
arxiv-2407-20631.creator: Arabinda Bera, Alessio Zaccone, Matteo Baggioli
arxiv-2407-20631.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Arabinda Bera, Alessio Zaccone, Matteo Baggioli. The underlying structural disorder renders the concept of topological defects in amorphous solids difficult to apply and hinders a first-principle identification of the microscopic carriers of plasticity and of the regions more prone to structural rearrangements (“soft spots”). Recently, it has been proposed that well-defined topological defects can still be identified in glasses, and correlated to local and global plasticity, by looking at the eigenvector field or the particle displacement field.

arxiv-2503-03512.title: An Aspect Extraction Framework using Different Embedding Types, Learning Models, and Dependency Structure
arxiv-2503-03512.creator: Ali Erkan, Tunga Güngör
arxiv-2503-03512.description: Abstract Aspect-based sentiment analysis has gained significant attention in recent years due to its ability to provide fine-grained insights for sentiment expressions related to specific features of entities. An important component of aspect-based sentiment analysis is aspect extraction, which involves identifying and extracting aspect terms from text.

arxiv-2504-15750.title: Unique Bernoulli Gibbs states and g -measures Thanks: Email: phulse@ed.ac.uk
arxiv-2504-15750.creator: Paul Hulse
arxiv-2504-15750.description: Abstract . A sufficient condition for the Gibbs states of a shift-invariant specification on a one-dimensional lattice to be the g g -chains for some continuous function g g is obtained. This is then used to derive criteria under which there is a unique Gibbs state, which is also shift-invariant and Bernoulli. amslplain 1.

arxiv-2508-17107.title: SugarcaneShuffleNet: A Very Fast, Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network for Diagnosis of 15 Sugarcane Leaf Diseases Journal: Computers and Electronics in Agriculture
arxiv-2508-17107.creator: Shifat E. Arman, Hasan Muhammad Abdullah, Syed Nazmus Sakib, RM Saiem, Shamima Nasrin Asha, Md Mehedi Hasan, Shahrear Bin Amin, S M Mahin Abrar
arxiv-2508-17107.description: Abstract Despite progress in AI-based plant diagnostics, sugarcane farmers in low-resource regions remain vulnerable to leaf diseases due to the lack of scalable, efficient, and interpretable tools. Many deep learning models fail to generalize under real-world conditions and require substantial computational resources, limiting their use in resource-constrained regions.

arxiv-2509-09202.title: Interacting k k -essence field with non-pressureless Dark Matter: Cosmological Dynamics and Observational Constraints
arxiv-2509-09202.creator: Saddam Hussain 1, Qiang Wu, Tao Zhu
arxiv-2509-09202.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Saddam Hussain 1, Qiang Wu, Tao Zhu. We investigate a class of interacting dark energy and dark matter (DM) models, where dark energy is modeled as a k k -essence scalar field with an inverse-square potential. Two general forms of interaction are considered: one proportional to the Hubble parameter, and another independent of the Hubble parameter, depending instead on combinations of the energy densities and pressures of the dark sectors.

europmc-pmc5964317.description: Microglia are highly motile glial cells that are proposed to mediate synaptic pruning during neuronal circuit formation. pmc-10715552.title: Income mortality paradox by immigrants’ duration of residence in Sweden: a population register-based study
pmc-10715552.creator: Alexander Miething, Sol P Juárez
pmc-10715552.description: BackgroundStudies have shown that, compared with the general native population, immigrants display weaker or absent income gradients in mortality. The aim of this study is to examine the extent to which the income gradient is modified by immigrants’ duration of residence in Sweden.

pmc-11410326.title: Textbook Outcomes in Solid Transplantation: A Systematic Review
pmc-11410326.creator: Alessandro Martinino, Joseph Matthew Ladowski, Davide Schilirò, Matthew G. Hartwig, Dimitrios Moris, Andrew S. Barbas
pmc-11410326.description: Background.The concept of TO is expanding across various surgical disciplines to establish a standardized, comprehensive quality benchmark. Traditional metrics such as 1-y patient and graft survival have been key for evaluating transplant program performance but are now deemed inadequate because of significant field advancements.

pmc-12992074.title: Development and characterization of high internal phase emulsions for lycopene encapsulation with safflower seed meal globulin modified via ultrasound, heating and pH-shifting
pmc-12992074.creator: Ke'er Xiao, Lingyu Gao, Qiuyu Lu, Qiaoyu Wang, Ziteng Zhao, Mukaddas Sai, Xinyu Meng, Lili Guan, Jing Yang, Linna Du
pmc-12992074.description: This study investigated the synergistic effect of ultrasound in combination with pH-shifting and heating modification on the physicochemical properties, structural characteristics, and emulsifying performance of safflower seed meal globulins (SMG). Furthermore, the efficacy of the modified protein (UHA-SMG) as a natural emulsifier was evaluated for preparing lycopene (LYC)-loaded high internal phase emulsions (HIPEs).

pmc-13206978.title: DNA Hypomethylation of MIR21 Drives Hsa-miR-21-5p Expression in High-Grade Meningiomas and Reshapes Transcriptomic Signatures of Oncogenic Pathways and Intercellular Communication
pmc-13206978.creator: Paulina Kober, Szymon Baluszek, Beata Joanna Mossakowska, Izabella Myśliwy, Biniyam Tsegaye, Artur Oziębło, Tomasz Mandat, Mateusz Bujko
pmc-13206978.description: Meningiomas are the most common intracranial tumors. DNA methylation analysis in benign and aggressive meningiomas showed decreased MIR21 methylation and overexpression of hsa-miR-21-5p in atypical and anaplastic tumors. Transcriptomic analysis of distinct WHO grade meningiomas showed multiple predicted hsa-miR-21-5p target genes as differentially expressed. They were mainly related to processes of intercellular and intracellular signaling.

pmc-13280819.title: Low-cost embedded system for spectral power distribution reconstruction for controlled environmental agriculture using a multispectral sensor and cloud-based deep learning
pmc-13280819.creator: Juan Morales-Guerra, Juan Soto-Perdomo, Juan Botero-Valencia, Erick Reyes-Vera, JM Pearce
pmc-13280819.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This work presents an open-source device for acquiring, correcting, and reconstructing the spectral power distribution (SPD) of LED sources used in controlled environmental agriculture. Unlike direct measurement spectrometers, the system employs a low-cost multispectral sensor (AS7265x, 18 channels, 410–940 nm) to acquire sparse band-integrated data, which are subsequently processed through a two-stage machine learning pipeline to infer a dense SPD representation. The sensor is integrated into an embedded platform that performs spectral acquisition, processing, wireless transmission, and remote visualization.

pmc-13555445.title: Transcervical Enucleation of a Giant Cervicothoracic Intramural Esophageal Spindle Cell Tumor
pmc-13555445.creator: Jacob Beiriger, Hilary C. McCrary, Kajsa Affolter, Nicolas Contreras
pmc-13555445.description: Mammary-type myofibroblastoma and spindle cell lipoma are rare benign spindle cell tumors commonly present in soft tissue sites. We report a novel case of a giant intramural retinoblastoma susceptibility gene (RB1)–deleted spindle cell neoplasm of the esophagus in a 61-year-old man with dysphagia. The 9-cm cervicothoracic tumor extended from the upper esophageal sphincter to the level of the aortic arch.

pmc-13581376.title: Staged EUS-guided gastroenterostomy for malignant gastric outlet obstruction
pmc-13581376.creator: Xiangyang Wang, Hui Chen, Peng Liu, Ya Peng
pmc-13581376.description: r seven patients with high-risk malnutrition. In the first stage, a nasojejunal nutrition tube was inserted into the distal jejunum of the obstruction under endoscopic guidance to establish an enteral nutrition pathway to correct hypoproteinemia and electrolyte imbalance. In the second stage, EUS-GE was performed after the improvement of nutritional status.

pmc-13653587.title: Post‐Synthetic Zinc Modifications to Correct Speciation in Ti‐MWW Zeolites for Catalytic Oxidation
pmc-13653587.creator: Christoph J Kaul, Lukas Lätsch, Alexander V Yakimov, Milivoj Plodinec, Xing Huang, Trees De Baerdemaeker, Jaroslaw Mormul, Peter Oechsle, Andrei‐Nicolae Parvulescu, J Henrique Teles, Christophe Copéret

However, the development of more active variants is often hampered by the lack of characterization methods able to track transformations and interplay between a multitude of species; this is further exacerbated by the use of post‐synthetic modifications.
